question: Find the value of [(17 times 10) timesleft{8 div 8 times ((19-12))/(7)right}]
solution:
**Given:**

Expression: [(17 × 10) × {8 ÷ 8 × ((19 - 12) ÷ 7)}]

**Formula used:**

Order of operations (BODMAS): Brackets, Orders (powers and roots, etc.), Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction

**Calculation:**

[(17 × 10) × {8 ÷ 8 × ((19 - 12) ÷ 7)}]

⇒ [(170) × {8 ÷ 8 × (7 ÷ 7)}]

⇒ [(170) × {1 × 1}]

⇒ [(170) × 1]

⇒ 170

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
